item.text: I’ll use the imagegen skill to edit Image 1, preserving the scene and name cards while adding the moon and changing the characters’ expressions and gaze.
The local skill file couldn’t be opened, but the image editor is available. I’ll place the crescent in the open wall space above Saraa, slightly below and to the right of the sun.
The edit has seven stars. I’m removing one to match your requested five or six.
Done—added the crescent moon and six felt stars, updated the expressions, and kept Mongle mouthless.
